Review Button-matched metrics, chevron alignment and focus rings for all appearance/size/state combinations on desktop targets.
Controlled/uncontrolled Menu latch, trigger-open close without reopen, action/dismiss reasons and caller changes without callbacks; disabled never opens and disabling closes family.
Disabled defaultOpen and opening Down key do not present menu or notify.

Physical Enter/Space/Down open to first, Up to last, pointer opens surface without highlighted row; readiness and native outcomes confirm focus.

Activation/root Escape/Shift+Tab return live eligible trigger; outside pointer respects another focused control; second trigger pointer closes old family and opens new.
Tab from any popup closes family and focuses next owner-window view; Win32 approved R1 returns trigger instead.
Closed actual root is button with menu hint, collapsed state, no checked state, root ref and no menu surface.

Qualify real menu behavior and native continuation on all four endpoints before public export, recording Win32 R1 distinctly.
